en.text: Thank you for watching, and I'll see you in the next video!
Don't let Geist get too close to you.
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
Rat King, I can heal you!
Check out what the Doorman bought.
I'm not ready for a team fight
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
The Deep will be safe once more.
You're all my new best friends.
You all are welcome in The Deep, but you'd probably drown.
Oh look I've made enemies - I feel more human already.
You're all about to learn the wonders of the Cube.
You'll like the cube. It's warm.
The Patron will make The Deep safe once more.
I'll stop The Adversary, no matter what it takes.
Check out what Rat King bought.
The ice man is over here.
I'm going to turn into a ball.
Who wants to see the sphere?
Ready to turn into a goo boulder.
Ready to turn into a ball of fun.
I'm ready to run them down.
Abrams is a killing machine. But not a literal machine. Because he's made of flesh and bone. But you can't see the bone. It's under his skin.
The guardian will deal with them.
Now's our chance to finish them off.
New Yorkers are nicer than I expected.
McGinnis, we're going to be friends forever.
Geist stole their life, like something that steals someone's life.
Wow. That's probably the reason you were locked away in an oubliette.
Seven's scary. But he's on our team, so it's a good scary.
I can see why they tried to execute you, Seven.
That was a lot of bullets.
Infernus, you're fun to burn things with.
Now I get to not die!
They took out the Rat King!
Shiv, you're really good at stabbing people.
I'm glad I'm not fighting Warden.
You won't get away with this!
I am very. VERY. Disappointed in you.
This isn't what I had in mind…
I need to find a place to train.
I'm alone out here, I need to be careful.
The enemy could be here any minute.
I might want to get back to the group…
It's dangerous here on the surface…
I never should have left The Deep.
I don't think I like the surface…
Maybe I should have stayed home…
This might not turn out the way I was thinking….
We need to be more careful…
We can't afford to mess up…
The next team fight could decide everything..
I need to throw more goo.
One of us is probably going to die.
New York is a scary place.
I sound happy but I'm scared.
I think I'm going to roll away.
I put a stop to that.
Oh well, I'll shoot her later.
That was never going to work, Bebop.
Your laser is just kind of sad, Bebop.
You'll have to do better than that, Bebop.
You thought you were clever, didn't you?
Look out for the black hole.
I'll destroy as many turrets as I can.
I got another of McGinnis' turrets.
Oh dear, they have the Rejuvenator.
We need to get on the defensive.
Don't let Geist get too close to you.
Goo doesn't care if you're visible or not.
I knocked her out of the sky.
Well that's not fair, she flies…
Now I know how people feel when I turn into goo…
That's what I like to see.
It seems like the plan is working…
See what we can accomplish together?
They have to be here somewhere…
Come back, surface dweller, I want to be friends… but first I have to shoot you.
This body is proving to be useful.
I never realized violence would be so exciting…
Oh the things you can do with arms and legs…
The Deep's grievances will be heard.
I hate fighting a fellow tourist.
Holliday won't be grabbing anyone for a while.
The blue creature is no longer a threat.
I thought tea was supposed to calm you down.
I'm glad the deep doesn't have pigeons.
I don't think I like birds.
We don't need to worry about Bebop anymore.
I like your sweater, Paige. It's green!
I hope she reads me a story that won't hurt me sometime.
Maybe later we could be friends, Paige.
She can't shield her team now.
Cadence won't be bothering us for a while
He must not be very good at protecting New York.
It's ok, old people die all the time.
She's clever. But now she's clever and dead.
That should buy us some time.
He loves Fairfax Industries as much as I love the cube.
He seemed like someone who would be friends with The Adversary.
I don’t think I wanna stay at his hotel.
I'm starting to think he's not actually a doorman.
I don't think that was finger paint on his hands.
He didn't have a happy smile, he had a scary smile.
We don't need to be afraid of a black hole for a while…
Sorry I had to kill you, Professor.
He seemed like a happy person.
I want to be Rem's friend.
I'll make it up to him with the Cube later.
You can't stab the Cube, silly.
Shouldn't you be in school, Apollo?
I killed a morally compromised scientist.
Fairfax Industries doesn’t hire good people.
You're kind of a monster, McGinnis.
Fairfax Industries has a lot to answer for.
He's made of body parts, I'm made of goo.
Now he's even sadder cause he's dead.
One day, I hope to cheer you up, Victor, but today I'm gonna hit you.
He needs the Cube in his life.
Turns out Geist isn't immortal, she's just a narcissist.
Seven seems like a bad person.
Hooray! One less government assassin to be scared of.
Haze won't hurt us anymore. Until she's back. Then she'll probably shoot us.
I won't let you hurt my friends.
Stop lighting things on fire, please.
You can't burn me, I'm goo.
I bet if you weren't trying to kill my friends I'd think you're really nice.
Now I have mole hair in my goo.
I bet before he was dead Mo gave nice hugs.
I hope they'll be my friend later.
I don't have anything against you, Lash, I'm just jumping on a bandwagon.
Lash thought he could kill me. He was wrong.
Sorry, Lash. That was sarcasm, I'm not actually sorry.
I'm not a rabbit. I'm goo.
They had marriage problems, but that doesn't matter because now they're dead.
I'm sorry Mirage, The Deep's problems are more serious than the Djinn's.
I have nothing against the Djinn, Mirage, but too much is at stake.
He was good person but only a so-so bodyguard.
Now that she's dead, I wonder if she could summon herself.
Graves shouldn't mind, she likes dead things.
I don't know if summoning the dead is a good idea, Graves.
I don't want arrows getting stuck in my goo.
That was one angry old man.
Talon didn't seem happy to see me.
I don't think he was very happy.
I can't let you stop us Venator.
Billy can't be so angry anymore because he's dead.
Billy would feel better in the Cube.
I wonder if he's angry all the time.
Billy doesn't seem like a very nice person.
I took down the Rat King.
I never realized that rats were so big.
I don't know if I like Ratannia.
I couldn't let Shiv kill me, because then I'd be dead.
Why's the Baxter Society hunting me?
We should have been on the same side, Pocket.
Can we still be friends, Pocket?
Until she was dead, she seemed like a happy person.
Silly Mina, I don't have blood, I have goo!
I don't need to drink blood, I have the Cube.
We don't need to worry about the vampire anymore.
She was dead, but now she's deader.
I don't think we should be friends, Vyper.
You should stop mugging people, Vyper, then you wouldn't be in jail.
Silly Vyper, you can't murder the Cube.
I couldn't let him hurt my friends.
I think Silver wanted to eat me.
I think I might have fur stuck in my goo.
I was hoping that werewolves would be nicer.
She won't be shooting us for a while.
If you didn’t try to stab my friends I wouldn't have to kill you.
She had a sword. It didn't help.
The Deep has proven its dominance…
Even in a borrowed body, no one can stop me…
Surface dwellers aren't so scary after all.
I'm rather good at violence, aren't I?
Time to keep this streak going…
I'm doing rather well aren't I…
The Deep will be silent no longer…
Do I have your attention now?
I need to find a puddle to hide in.
Where did all my friends go?
This got a lot more intense…
When I'm in the cube it's warm. I like being in the cube. You seem to like revenge so I wonder if it feels the same.
Then why do you want to live in it?
I didn't mean to offend you, I'm just socially awkward.
Who is The Adversary and why are they massacring the denizens of The Deep?
And I have further to go to stop The Adversary.
I can be a ball! You can move me!
Can I sit on your bench?
Does that mean you want me to guess?
I can't tell which one of us was being rude.
Miss Shelly sounds like a nice lady.
Do you think she'd like being in The Cube?
I hear Lash doesn't like you
Really? I thought that the tingly feeling means I was nervous.
Why do people like to talk to you so much?
Wouldn't that make everyone mad at you?
Then why don't more people do that?
No. The cube is free to anyone who needs it.
The world would have an Adversary problem.
How are you able to talk?
I hear you drink people's blood.
I bet that makes it hard to make friends.
I don't have blood, so we can be friends!
Before the ritual, I heard you tell someone that you wanted to see what their insides look like.
I bet if you spent more time in the cube, you'd spend less time murdering people.
No. You'll like it, everyone likes the cube.
Oh, that sounds more fun. OK!
Is dangerous. And it's only a matter of time before he tires of The Deep and comes for you on land.
You said I should attend, and I said Ok.
Do they teach you about the Deep in school?
I've never been to Ixia, what's it like?
Then why are people fighting? Shouldn't they be happy?
I don't have a nose. But if I did I bet your hair would smell like flowers.
The adversary… he comes for The Deep. And if I don't stop him, he'll come for everything.
But after the ritual The Adversary will be gone.
Thanks for your help Haze, not everyone takes the problems of The Deep seriously.
Would you like to be in The Cube? No one's angry in The Cube.
It really sounds like you need The Cube.
You look too young to be a ghost.
Do you always dress fancy or is it just for work?
Have you ever explored the deep?
If you do, can I be your guide?
You have a dome. I have a cube.
We do! We also both know that the cube is better.
I would. Because it's better. It's The Cube.
What's it like being dead, but not dead?
That doesn't sound much different than being alive. I'm confused all the time.
That doesn't sound confusing. That sounds scary.
I don’t have fur, I’m goo
I need to stop The Adversary
If you hate people why do you want to be cheered by them so badly?
I don't carry knives. Vyper does though, should I get her?
Oh. OK, I can do that.
Do you want to spend time in the cube? It's where I go when I'm sad. Or injured. Or just want to be in the cube.
The Baxter Society hunts monsters, right?
If we fail to summon The Patron, do you think they can help stop The Adversary.
You'll probably be dead. I'm goo. I'll be fine.
At your fragile age I think you'll find the cube to be quite helpful.
No, you are. But you lie to yourself because you're a human.
I don't know what that means.
So you did a ritual before doing The Ritual?
No, not an adversary. The Adversary. It's… it's evil. And it's a danger to The Deep.
If you don't die today I'll tell you everything.
I didn’t know rats were so cuddly.
Why did your mom named you Vyper?
Goo hits harder than you'd think, doesn't it…
I need to get into more fist fights, that was exciting…
Who would have thought that punching strangers would feel so good?
I'm tougher than I thought I was…
I just won a melee, that's exciting.
It's ok, I'll have another chance to kill them.
I shouldn't try to win this fight…
This body is more capable than I thought.
Glad I got that before anyone else did.
Well this was careless of someone to leave behind.
I didn't forget about what you did.
Coming to the surface was a mistake…
I wish I could pilot this body better…
We need to turn things around…
They're gonna be tough to stop…
Most of my kind find legs to be unnerving, but I rather enjoy them.
I was hoping that this suit would make people take the problems of The Deep seriously. I'm not sure it's working.
I am not a pile of goo. I'm merely piloting a pile of goo…
You don't know how easy you have it on the surface.
I think I'll like the surface.
I represent the concerns of The Deep.
There's more going on in this world than what you perceive.
I can afford some new gear.
I might want to revisit the store.
I should see what I can buy.
Time to go to the store again.
I should see what they have at the store.
No point in holding onto all these souls.
They can have some extra souls, we don't need them.
One step closer to completing the ritual…
I need to do research on The Adversary.
I was planning on trying to use stairs today anyway.
When you need to be trapped in a protoplasmic cube you're going to be thinking: Man, I wish I had Viscous's help. He seemed like a nice person who would trap me in a protoplasmic cube.
There's so much to see in New York.
The Patrons can wait, I want to see South Pacific.
If I had a mouth I'd eat my feelings.
Are you sure? I'm fun to be around?
Once again, the needs of The Deep are ignored.
I'm going to go free my brothers from the prison known as "The Aquarium."
Today I'll explore the mysteries of Long Island.
Today, I'll explore the mysteries of Staten Island.
Today, I'll explore the mysteries of Secaucus.
Today, I'll explore the mysteries of New Jersey.
I can't just rely on my weapon…
I don't get why people think it's gross.
The surface can get dangerous quick.
I need to be able to defend myself.
I can't be defensive all the time.
I'm tired of being pushed around.
It's not just restorative, it's great for your skin.
They'll be safe in my cube. Well, safe-ish.
The surface is a dangerous place.
I leave a piece of The Deep behind wherever I go.
New York is already messy, they won't notice.
The puddles will keep me safe.
People think it's gross, I think it's home.
I need to keep an eye out for the goo.
I'm going to metaphorically punch them. The metaphor is goo.
You can't tell, but I smile when I use this.
People think this is a little silly. Then I punch them and they don't think that anymore because they're concussed.
I'll take them for a ride.
They'll think it’s a puddle of goo… then it'll punch them in the face.
It's like a handshake but better.
People love it when I use this.
It's like the cube, but a sphere.
Cubes are for healing. Balls are for murder.
I wish I could roll in this all day. That's hyperbole.
This is more fun than the subway.
It's a little messy, but it's worth it.
I'm going to crush our enemies.
They'll try to get away, but it won't matter because I'm going to run them over.
I'm going to be a sphere.
I'm not worried about their weapons…
Bullets aren't going to hurt me…
Life is simpler in the Cube.
Let the calm wash over you.
Who wants to see a goo fist?
It's funny because I'm basically immortal.
I'm going to steal their life.
